## Verification

List analyze, tests, builds and physical-device or interoperability checks performed.

## Privacy and release checklist

- [ ] No credential, private host, SSID/BSSID, device identifier or local absolute path is included.
- [ ] Unavailable or denied platform data is not replaced with simulated output.
- [ ] Long-running work supports failure, cancellation and disposal where applicable.
- [ ] Permissions, privacy, platform and third-party documentation is updated if needed.
- [ ] UI changes include original, sanitized screenshots where useful.
